transfer-of-wealth.note: Run HQ; if successful take 1 tag, the Corp loses 3 and the Runner gains 2 per credit actually lost.

transport-monopoly.note: 2 agenda counters on score; once per turn during a run, a counter: the run cannot be declared successful.

tread-lightly.note: Run any server; ice rez cost +3 during that run.

trebuchet.note: Take 1 bad publicity on rez; trash 1 installed Runner card; trace 6: the Runner cannot steal or trash this run.

tree-line.note: Expendable from HQ: 3 advancements on 1 installed ice; advanceable, +1 strength per advancement; gain 1 and end the run.

tremolo.note: Interface 3 credits breaks up to 2 barrier subroutines, 1 less per installed cybernetic hardware; 2 credits +2 strength.

tributary.note: Unique; the first run begin each turn may move it to the outermost position of the attacked server; may draw 1 and may install ice from HQ on another server ignoring costs; all ice +2 for the run.

trick-shot.note: 4 credits hosted, spendable during runs; run R&D, on success 2 more and 1 additional access; when the run ends may run a remote.

trickster-taka.note: Unique; 1 credit at turn begin and on each steal; hosted credits pay for programs during runs; at 3+ at turn end take 1 tag or trash it.

trieste-model-bioroids.note: On rez the Corp chooses 1 rezzed bioroid ice; Runner card abilities cannot break its subroutines.

trust-operation.note: Play only if tagged; trash 1 installed resource; install and rez 1 Archives card ignoring all costs through install_corp_card.

abilities: During the first encounter each turn with a piece of ice protecting the chosen server, whenever the Corp would resolve a subroutine, instead they resolve "[subroutine] Do 1 net damage."
tsakhia-bankhar-gantulga.note: The replacement is marked on the encounter itself and checks the server the ice protects; a later encounter with the same ice that turn is not replaced.
tsakhia-bankhar-gantulga.test: uses the server the ice protects, and only the turn's first such encounter: a second encounter with the same ice is not replaced (CR 1.2.1)

abilities: Persistent → Whenever an agenda is scored or stolen from the root of this server, you may search R&D for 1 piece of ice. Install and rez that ice, paying a total of 3[credit] less.
tucana.note: Area 10 (persistent flag readers): the condition and install need Tucana installed, so after the Runner trashes it nothing persists. Area 5: the ice is installed only protecting Tucana's own server, inline.

tunnel-vision.note: Turn begin: identify mark; interface 2 credits breaks up to 2 subroutines while attacking the mark; 2 credits +2 strength.

tyr.note: Unique; the Runner may lose a click to break 1 chosen subroutine and the Corp gets +1 allotted click next turn; 2 core damage; trash 1 installed Runner card and gain 3; end the run.

ubiquitous-vig.note: Advanceable; turn begin: gain 1 per advancement counter.

abilities: Interface → 2[credit]: Break up to 3 code gate subroutines. If at least 1 subroutine was broken this way, each player may draw 1 card.
umbrella.note: The paid break checked neither strength nor the trojan-host limit. Both are now checked when it is used. The draws match.
umbrella.test: Umbrella cannot break a code gate that hosts no trojan, even at full strength (card text, CR 1.2.1)

underdome-irregulars.note: Runner action phase ends: if ice was rezzed this turn draw 2 or remove 1 tag, else trash this.

unity.note: Decoder 1 strength: 1 credit breaks 1 code gate subroutine; 1 credit +X strength, X = installed icebreakers.

unleash.note: Additional cost: remove 1 tag; rez 1 installed ice ignoring costs, may resolve 1 of its subroutines.

abilities: [subroutine] Give the Runner 1 tag. / [subroutine] Do 2 net damage. / [subroutine] You may draw 2 cards.
unsmiling-tsarevna.note: The IR has two subroutines, net damage then tag: the 'You may draw 2 cards' subroutine is missing and the first two are in the wrong order. The rez ability (give 2 credits, at most 1 printed subroutine broken per encounter) matches. Paired cut A: subroutines in printed order, with the "you may draw 2 cards" subroutine.

urban-art-vernissage.note: At turn begin may add an installed non-virus trojan to the grip to host 2 credits; hosted credits pay installs.

abilities: When the Runner accesses this asset while it is installed, do 2 net damage plus 1 per advancement counter
urtica-cipher.note: The card has no onAccessRequiresInstalled flag, so the damage also fires when it is accessed in HQ, R&D or Archives. Paired cut A: add the flag.

utae.note: Interface X credits breaks X code gate subroutines once per run; 1 credit breaks 1 with 3+ virtual resources; 1 credit +1 strength.

valentao.note: Rez additional cost: take 1 bad publicity or remove 1 tag; gain 2; Runner loses 2; end the run if the Corp has more credits.

abilities: Threat 3 → When you install this resource during your turn, you may remove 1 tag or gain 2[credit].
valentina-ferreira-carvalho.note: The install trigger has no 'during your turn' condition, so an install on the Corp's turn also gets it. The plan's cut A list notes the same missing Runner-turn condition for Aggressive Trendsetting. The tag-removal gain matches. Paired cut A: a "during your turn" condition on the install trigger, with its engine op (as Aggressive Trendsetting).

vampyronassa.note: Runner loses 2; gain 2; 2 net damage; may draw 1 or 2.

abilities: Once per turn → [click]: Install 1 card from HQ, ignoring all costs.
When the Runner trashes this asset, you may install 1 card from HQ, ignoring all costs. You cannot install that card in the root of this server.
vaporframe-fabricator.note: Area 5 (Corp install): both abilities install through install_hq_card_ignore_costs (inline, faceup, no new remote for ice, no trash of an agenda or asset in the root), as S1b found. Area 1 (trash hooks): onTrash fires when the Corp trashes it too. The excluded-root rule matches. cr-checker: CR 1.14.5a (who carries out the trash); it may also fire for an unrezzed card trashed on access (CR 9.1.8g), not tested.

abilities: When the Runner encounters this ice, you may pay 1[credit]. If you do, place 1 advancement counter on an installed card you can advance.
vasilisa.note: Area 11 (additional costs): the 1 credit is paid with lose_credits, so with 0 credits the counter is still placed (CR 1.16.10b). The pick is fixed in engine#948 (the Corp chooses).

abilities: Whenever an agenda is scored or stolen, you may reveal the grip. Trash 1 card revealed this way.
vera-ivanovna-shuyskaya.note: may_trash_one_from_grip first asks the Corp whether to reveal the grip (no card named), then reveals it to both players and makes the Corp trash 1 revealed card, with no Decline.
vera-ivanovna-shuyskaya.test: the Corp does not see the grip before choosing to reveal it, and after the reveal must trash 1 revealed card (CR 10.2.2a, 1.21.3)

verbal-plasticity.note: Unique; first basic draw action each turn draws 2 instead.

vertigo.note: On pass with no clicks left, Runner cannot steal or trash this run; Runner loses a click.

vicsek.note: X net damage and X tags, X = Runner's tags; 1 tag and trash this ice.

virtual-intelligence-p-i-you-can-call-me.note: Once per turn, click, 1 credit: draw 1 and remove 1 tag.

virtual-service-agent.note: On pass after an encounter, 1 tag unless its printed subroutine was broken by a decoder; Runner loses 1.

virtuoso.note: Unique console, +1 MU; turn begin identify mark; first successful mark run each turn: +1 HQ access if the mark is HQ, else breach HQ when the run ends.

abilities: Once per turn → 2 hosted advancement counters: Place 2 advancement counters on another card you can advance in the root of this server.
vladisibirsk-city-grid.note: Fixed by PF-S1's place_advancements change (the Corp chooses among several candidates in the root, itself excluded); confirmed in PF-S2 (engine#950).
vladisibirsk-city-grid.test: Vladisibirsk City Grid: the Corp chooses which other card in its root gets the counters (CR 1.15.2)

vovo-ozetti.note: Unique; ice protecting this server costs 2 less to rez; Threat 4 root cards too; at Corp turn end may move to another root.

vrcation.note: Draw 4; lose a click if any remain.

vulnerability-audit.note: Cannot be scored the turn it is installed.

wage-workers.note: Unique; gain [click] when an action is finished for the third time this turn.

wake-implant-v2a-jrj.note: Unique; 1 meat damage on install; power counter on each successful HQ run; on R&D breach may remove up to 3 for that many more accesses (a choice of how many, src/state/access.ts).

wall-to-wall.note: Unique; at Corp turn begin resolve 1 option if another asset is rezzed, otherwise up to 3 different ones: draw 1, gain 1, advance an installed ice, add Wall to Wall to HQ.

abilities: When your turn begins, you may install 1 card from HQ. You cannot score that card this turn.
warm-reception.note: Area 5 (Corp install): may_install_from_hq_paying_costs always makes a new remote. The no-score lock and the derez pair on an unprotected server match.

abilities: you may search R&D for a piece of ice and reveal it. (Shuffle R&D after searching it.) Add that ice to HQ.
wave.note: Area 13 (search): search_rd_type_to_hq takes the first match, the Corp cannot fail to find, and R&D is not shuffled on a miss. Executive Boot Camp, Levy University and Fast Track share the kind.

abilities: Whenever you advance a card, gain 2 credits if it had no advancement counters
weyland-consortium-built-to-last.note: The 10.3.1a hook reads only cards advanced since the previous checkpoint (advanceCard, and Success's advance), so placing or moving counters no longer gains 2.
weyland-consortium-built-to-last.test: placing counters with Seamless Launch is not advancing, so it gains nothing (CR 1.18.2)

abilities: Whenever you make a successful run, you may trash this resource to choose a card name. The next time this run you access an agenda with the chosen name, steal it, ignoring all costs.
whistleblower.note: may_trash_name_agenda_steal_ignore_costs names from every agenda name in the catalog, not from the Corp's cards in the game.
whistleblower.test: the Runner names from every agenda name, not from the Corp's cards, so the list shows nothing in HQ or R&D (CR 10.2.2a, 10.2.2b)

whitespace.note: Runner loses 3 credits; end the run if the Runner has 6 credits or less.

wildcat-strike.note: Corp chooses: Runner gains 6 credits or draws 4.

winchester.note: Trace 4: trash a program; trace 3: trash a hardware; while protecting HQ it gains 'trace 3: end the run' after its other subroutines.

abilities: You may install 1 program or piece of hardware from your grip.
window-of-opportunity.note: Area 6 (Runner install): may_install_from_grip drops programs over free MU, trojans and install-on-ice cards. The run, the derez at run begin and the Corp's free rez at run end match.

witch-hunt.note: Bad publicity on score or steal; Corp action phase end after scoring it this turn: remove all tags, give 3.

word-on-the-street.note: Unique; additional cost to score an agenda installed this turn: Corp adds it to their score area as a -1 agenda they cannot forfeit; when the Corp scores an agenda not installed this turn, trash it, gain 4, draw 1.

working-prototype.note: A power counter on every rez (itself included); [click], counter: gain 3; [click], 5 counters: gain 6 and add an installed resource to the top of the stack.

abilities: you may trash 1 of your other installed cards to search your stack for 1 card of the same type. Install the card you found, paying 3[credit] less.
world-tree.note: Area 6 (Runner install): searchStackTypeInstall uses the same filters, so a program that would exceed free MU, a trojan or an install-on-ice program cannot be found and installed. The once-per-turn trigger, the trash and the discount match.

abilities: Whenever a player trashes a card (including this upgrade) from the root of this server or protecting it, except during installation, gain 2[credit].
yakov-erikovich-avdakov.note: A trashed Yakov pays only if it was rezzed when trashed; other cards in its server pay only while Yakov is rezzed.
yakov-erikovich-avdakov.test: an unrezzed Yakov the Runner trashes gives the Corp nothing; a rezzed one gives 2 credits (CR 9.1.8g)

zahya-sadeghi-versatile-smuggler.note: Once per turn, when an HQ or R&D run ends, may gain 1 credit per card accessed.

zato-city-grid.note: Remote only; ice protecting this server: on encounter the Corp may trash it to resolve 1 chosen subroutine.

zenit-chip-jz-2mj.note: Unique; 1 core damage on install; first successful central run each turn draws 1.
